_comment: Ids of template records (entered by hand in Optima) that new records are cloned from. checks preflight verifies they exist before every import. If a template disappears or changes, pick a new document of the same type from the last month. Values below are examples.

purchase._comment: purchase in PLN: ZAKUP 1/1 + DW 1/2 (sales register, output VAT) + DW 4/1 (purchase register, input VAT)

other._comment: purchase in EUR in the INNE 0/1 register, no DW

br._comment: BR/01/MM/YYYY: SPRZEDAŻ 0/2 ZW + cash payment settled by an RVS entry in the cash report
